summary: Iter21: Backend + Frontend testing of Finora Email Delivery Log. Backend pytest 10/10 pass in /app/backend/tests/test_email_log.py: platform_admin AuthZ (consultant + tenant-B owner get 403 on GET /api/platform/email-log and POST /sync); GET list returns items/total/counts/tracking/synced_at with no _id leak; q searches to+subject case-insensitive; kind filter respects allowed enum; counts ignore the status filter; pagination via skip+limit; items sorted by 'at' desc; POST /platform/email-log/sync parses postfix/cleanup message-id lines and postfix/smtp status lines to map queued rows to delivered / deferred / bounced, plus postfix/qmgr status=expired -> bounced; a second sync returns updated=0 (offset preserved via db.system_state id='mail_log'); truncation restart-from-0 works; POST /api/public/inquiries creates an email_log row with kind='inquiry', message_id stripped of angle brackets, status in {logged,queued}. Frontend: logged in as ryuichi.kurozaki@gmail.com, /platform → platform-tab-email_log opens email-log-panel with email-log-table, 5 rows including seeded test0/1/2, all 7 status chips (email-log-chip-{all|delivered|queued|deferred|bounced|failed|logged}) render with counts; email-log-search + email-log-search-btn filter 5→3; email-log-kind='inquiry' filters to 1 row; email-log-chip-bounced filters to 1 (test0 dsn=5.1.1 host said: 550 5.1.1 user unknown — details rendered under status); email-log-sync-btn triggers /platform/email-log/sync and shows Sonner toast '配信状況を更新しました（0件）' (uses el_synced replaced token); email-log-prev/next present; email-log-total shows '5 件 · 最終更新 …'. Row/status testids email-log-row-{id} and email-log-status-{id} present. i18n keys (el_*) are wired via useApp.t; per-row 種類 labels render (お問い合わせ / 招待 / 請求書 / 返金 / その他).

ui_bugs.issue: The platform TabsList uses shadcn's default `inline-flex ... whitespace-nowrap` and DOES NOT wrap on mobile. At 390px, computed style is `flex-wrap: nowrap` and document.scrollWidth=852 vs clientWidth=390 (horizontal page overflow). Review request explicitly requires the Platform tab list to wrap on mobile with no horizontal page overflow. Fix: add `flex-wrap` (e.g. className='flex flex-wrap h-auto ... bg-white/70') to the <TabsList>.

issues: Pre-existing React hydration warning: <span data-ve-dynamic> inside <option> (dev-only instrumentation, non-blocking, unchanged from iter20).

action_items: HIGH: Make the Platform TabsList wrap on mobile — add `flex flex-wrap h-auto` to <TabsList className=…> in /app/frontend/src/pages/Platform.jsx:114 (or override via a wrapper) so the 7 platform tabs no longer overflow horizontally at 390px. The inner email-log table already scrolls horizontally within its card and is correct.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/mail_log.py: parse() is compact and correct — last status per queue_id wins (later smtp entry overwrites earlier deferred, matching Postfix retry semantics). Detail is truncated to 300 chars — good. MAP includes expired→bounced via RE_EXPIRED separately.

backend/mail_log.py sync(): correctly persists inode+offset in db.system_state, handles logrotate by reading MAIL_LOG_PATH+'.1' when inode changed, and resets offset to 0 on truncation (offset > size). No _id leak in list_log() (projection {'_id':0}).
backend/mail_log.py list_log(): counts aggregation intentionally ignores the status filter (uses base filter) so status chips still show totals — behavior verified end-to-end.

backend/email_service.py _record(): message_id is stripped of angle brackets, ensuring it matches Postfix cleanup log's <message-id> capture. send_email correctly writes status='failed' AND re-raises on SMTP exception, and status='queued' on success; EMAIL_TRANSPORT=log writes status='logged' and returns the Message-ID.

frontend/EmailLogPanel.jsx: sound, minimal component — chips, filters, pagination, sync all wired to /api/platform/email-log via authenticated api client; toast on sync uses t('el_synced') replace token.
frontend/pages/Platform.jsx: TabsList lacks responsive flex-wrap — the only concrete regression found in this iter.

success_rate.frontend: ~90% — all email-log flows work; Platform tab list mobile-wrap regression is the only failing check

context_for_next_testing_agent: Regression suite: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_email_log.py. Note: /tmp/finora_mail.log offset is persisted in db.system_state id='mail_log'; if you clear the file, next sync auto-resets. On mobile 390px, once the TabsList wrap fix is applied, expect document.scrollWidth == 390 and TabsList parent computed flex-wrap == 'wrap'.
rca of the issue: Platform tab list overflow: shadcn's TabsList is `inline-flex items-center whitespace-nowrap`. With 7 items and their padding at 390px the intrinsic width is ~852px, so the page scrolls horizontally. Fix by overriding className on <TabsList> to add `flex-wrap h-auto` (h-auto because default is fixed h-9).
